prompts.atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game sprite atlas for a premium arcade brick breaker named Prism Breaker. Create ONE polished 1536x1024 atlas with a perfectly regular 3-column by 4-row grid (each cell 512x256), exactly one isolated game object centered in each cell and no grid lines. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, preserve alpha, no text, no labels, no contact shadows outside silhouettes. Orthographic FRONT VIEW with slight bevel depth, consistent light from upper left. Jewel-like photoreal 3D game art, immaculate polished crystal, brushed platinum and subtle pale gold fittings, physically plausible caustics, precise silhouettes, refined tiny engraved details, luxurious high-end console game item finish. Rows 1 and 2: SIX separate horizontal crystal bricks, each a clean rectangular rounded bevel block with 3:1 body aspect ratio, approximately 400 by 130 pixels, same silhouette, not irregular rocks. Row1 left violet amethyst, middle cyan aquamarine, right coral ruby. Row2 left luminous emerald, middle warm citrine gold, right pink diamond. Each brick has a small geometric cut crystal jewel embedded centrally, internal crystalline fractures, tasteful metal endcaps, translucent luminous interior. Row3 left: a horizontal platinum and violet glass sci-fi paddle, sleek symmetrical body 440x85 pixels with jewel core and twin violet energy tips. Row3 middle: one perfectly round luminous white pearl energy ball with a prismatic glass rim, diameter100pixels, compact glow. Row3 right: one single angular amethyst crystal shard, size110pixels. Row4 left: a small circular premium crystal lens icon violet and silver, diameter120pixels. Row4 middle: one isolated radiant cyan four-point impact star with short delicate splinters, 170pixels across. Row4 right: one small crystalline purple heart life icon, size110pixels. Objects never cross cell boundaries; leave generous transparent space. No floor, no checkerboard, no lettering, no HUD, no arrows, no cartoon, no pixel art. This atlas will be cropped into actual in-game sprites.
prompts.sanctum: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square in-game playfield background, 1536x1536. Create an exquisitely crafted high-end 3D art environment for a prismatic crystal brick-breaker, titled internally Violet Sanctum. A straight-on, symmetrical view into a vast dark art-deco cathedral floating in space, polished obsidian, fine platinum inlays, tall faceted amethyst columns only at extreme LEFT and RIGHT margins, layered celestial circular architecture subtly visible deep in the center. Delicate lavender volumetric light, subdued stars and suspended dust, physically plausible glass refractions, intricate high craftsmanship, cinematic depth. Gameplay readability is critical: the central 82% of the square is a very dark smooth open playing area; all brighter detailed architecture is confined to outer 8% edges and top 7%. Bottom is dark shadow, no platform, no horizon line across center. The top center can show a tiny distant glowing geometric shrine. Palette deep ink navy, restrained ultraviolet, platinum, tiny pale gold. Rich atmospheric depth, not a flat gradient, not vector art. NO bricks, NO paddle, NO ball, NO text, NO logo, NO UI, NO characters. Deliver an actual usable background plate, not a screenshot of a game.
prompts.aurora: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square in-game playfield background, 1536x1536. A premium cinematic 3D game environment for a crystal brick-breaker: the Aurora Conservatory. Straight-on symmetrical architectural framing, ancient futuristic glass observatory beneath an aurora-filled night sky. Elegant emerald crystal columns and pale gold engraved arches ONLY at the extreme LEFT/RIGHT edges, hanging glass prisms at the very top edge. Vast atmospheric depth, tasteful teal volumetric light, subtle nebula through distant vaulted glass, luxurious polished dark jade and metal, impeccable material detail and physical reflections. Central 82% of square must remain deep dark navy-green, calm, uncluttered and low contrast for moving balls and bricks to remain readable. Only outer8% and top7% can have brighter details; no floor or horizontal platform. A faint distant circular celestial vault center. Palette dark ink, aquamarine, emerald, champagne gold. NO gameplay objects, no bricks, no paddle, no ball, no text, no logos, no characters, no UI. Not flat illustration: exceptionally refined 3D environment art with cinematic indirect lighting.
prompts.cover: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape game key art, 1536x1024, for Prism Breaker. Premium polished 3D cinematic artwork for a luxurious crystal brick-breaker. In a mysterious art-deco violet crystal cathedral, a brilliantly luminous pearl orb flies on a graceful lavender arc toward an architectural mosaic of six jewel colors, shattering one central amethyst brick into exquisite refractive shards and pale gold filaments. Elegant symmetrical platinum and violet crystal paddle hovers in lower center. Highly detailed glass bevels, brushed metal, cinematic volumetric light, velvety ink shadows, magical but sophisticated, pristine next-generation game art. Composition: lavish jewel structure and action across upper 65%, lower third dark and calm for HTML title overlay; focal point central, no excessive explosion clutter. Palette amethyst purple, deep midnight navy, icy cyan and restrained champagne gold, small coral accents. No text, no logos, no HUD, no buttons, no pixel art, no simple vector shapes. Distinct refined jewel arcade identity, not generic spaceship combat.

processing: Sprite regions are extracted and silhouette-clipped for the game atlas. Source artwork retained in assets/prism-breaker-source; optimized WebP assets in games/prism-breaker/web/art.
